scope: DWG GROUP description versus dictionary identity, validated adapter name resolution, and source-handle preservation for repeated GROUP exports

authority.dwgLayout: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.4.72, pages 191-192 visually reviewed
authority.dwgLayoutCeiling: The table labels the TV as a group name. Its byte layout is unchanged; producer-paired evidence distinguishes its description text from dictionary identity.
authority.peerSourceCorroboration: ACadSharp readGroup/writeGroup map the TV to Group.Description; LibreDWG maps the same text to DXF 300. Source implementations are corroboration, not native qualification.

producerEvidence.artifactUse: Existing tracked/clean peer-repository inputs read in place. No external drawing copied or committed.

implementation.nativeReader: The bounded TV populates m_description; name stays unresolved at the low-level callback, matching DXF callback semantics.
implementation.nativeWriter: Emit m_description, including empty descriptions. Reject embedded NUL or malformed UTF-8 before bytes. Facade dictionary registration still requires a valid nonempty name/key.
implementation.adapterIdentity: Both source formats resolve name from a complete unique NOD/ACAD_GROUP dictionary graph and reciprocal owner; prepopulated conflicts remain refused. Description is never used as an identity substitute.
implementation.repeatExportFinding: An ASCII export changed borrowed LINE handles from 1280/1281 while GROUP member IDs remained in the source namespace. The subsequent encoding failed during OBJECTS emission.
implementation.repeatExportFix: Latch the existing scoped source-identity guard for GROUP graphs before their list is adopted by the writer. Rename the private flag to m_preserveGraphSourceIdentities; retain callback-local child lifetimes, bounds, exception restoration and HATCH behavior.
implementation.compatibility: Source compatibility checked; no binary ABI or native UI claim. Low-level GROUP callback name is intentionally no longer mislabelled body description.

generatedControls.sourceIdentityChecks: Source GROUP/member/LINE graph remains unchanged after each successful or failed export
generatedControls.fixtures: Runtime generated from scratch; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture added

sourceAndPeerProbes.identityProbeResults: Generated control plus both producer samples pass dictionary-key/description/member-count identity checks. This does not qualify full drawing conversion.
sourceAndPeerProbes.independentGeneratedGroup: Peer reads the generated GROUP body text as GROUP_DESCRIPTION_IS_DISTINCT and retains member handles 1280/1281. Its JSON property is named name; it is not the dictionary key.
sourceAndPeerProbes.independentGraphLimit: The same peer reports one generated ACAD_GROUP dictionary item but an empty items map, while the producer Leader positive control exposes *A1 -> 829. Thus external dictionary/whole-graph writer interoperability is not established and remains a local trace-driven follow-up.
sourceAndPeerProbes.sourceCli: Both producer drawings pass GROUP capture/name preflight, then remain refused by strict DWG completeness. The ACadSharp drawing retains 29 integrity mismatches; Leader retains 12. No guard was relaxed.
sourceAndPeerProbes.generatedCli: Corrected supported -v2010 Binary CLI probe with --allow-partial-dwg-read succeeds and emits the explicit partial-output warning. Initial -v2018 usage rejection was a CLI option error, not format evidence.

finalCliProbe.scope: Generated GROUP subset under explicit bounded partial mode only; strict conversion refusal and owner/reference gates remain intact.

remainingCompleteOutputGap.policy: Legacy plus strict owners implies RequireComplete. Keep that refusal; explicit AllowPartial projections above prove the GROUP subset only, not complete source retention.
remainingCompleteOutputGap.next: Implement bounded, source-bound standard-object raw-companion retention and qualified output handoff; never clear read receipts or increment retention counters without retaining the exact corresponding frames.

validation.redBeforeFix: All six literal native GROUP TV assertions failed; repeated conversion exposed source/member ID divergence and second-encoding emission failure.

worktree: Uncommitted and unstaged; pre-existing overlapping edits preserved
